(async()=>{const store=await import('/src/studio/assistant/workPacketStore.ts');const state=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const project=state.useStudio.getState().job.id;const packets=await store.listWorkPackets(project);const p=packets[0];const events=await store.readWorkEvents(p.id);if(!await store.verifyWorkJournal(p,events))throw Error('Broken audit chain');if(!events.some(e=>e.kind==='tool-result'))throw Error('No actual tool receipt');if(p.pendingAction)throw Error('Unexpected pending action');if((await store.listWorkPackets('unrelated-project')).length)throw Error('Cross-project leak');window.packetProof={id:p.id,project,eventCount:events.length};return window.packetProof})()

(async()=>{const model=await import('/src/studio/assistant/workPacket.ts');const store=await import('/src/studio/assistant/workPacketStore.ts');const p=model.createWorkPacket('Isolated CAS fixture',{projectId:'qa-cas-only',projectName:'QA fixture',projectRevision:1,designRevision:null,site:null,activeDocumentId:null,page:1,sources:[],recoveryBlocked:false});const saved=await store.saveWorkEvent(p,'intake',{});const results=await Promise.allSettled([store.saveWorkEvent(saved,'writer-a',{}),store.saveWorkEvent(saved,'writer-b',{})]);if(results.filter(r=>r.status==='fulfilled').length!==1)throw Error('CAS allowed racing writers');const current=(await store.listWorkPackets('qa-cas-only'))[0];if(!await store.verifyWorkJournal(current,await store.readWorkEvents(current.id)))throw Error('Atomic audit mismatch');return {racingWriters:'one accepted, one rejected',sequence:current.sequence}})()
